comment: X5.13: Quanser-style rotary double inverted pendulum on the spatial multibond stdlib. World -> Mount -> J1 (Revolute3D about world z, the arm) -> arm bar (RigidBody3D) -> J2 (Revolute3D about the arm axis, the lower link) -> J3 (upper link), every body a RigidBody3D with a distributed mass (COM at the bar middle). The arm is driven by an SRV02-like servo: Motor (ElectricDrive, voltage input) -> Shaft (ElasticShaft) -> Gear (IdealGear, 70:1) -> J1.drive. The 1 kHz firmware Ctrl (phases: idle, TVLQR swing-up along the collocation trajectory, latched LQR balance) reads the joint angles and rates. Dist is a force pulse on the tip of the upper link. Joint compliance kt = kr = 1e6 (N/m, N m/rad); every state is integral.
comment_free: X5.13 design check: the same bond graph released at rest from a non-trivial pose with the controller disabled (t_on far in the future, no disturbance). design.py integrates its Lagrangian model from the same pose; expected.json compares the link angles.
